notes:
## New features & enhancements

- A song title too long for its line on the main radio now scrolls slowly along it, the same way it does on the mini radio, once the pulse that marks a new song has finished.
- Song titles are tidier: a featured artist already named beside the artist is not repeated in brackets, and labels such as [Album Version] or (Explicit) are left off.
- On the mini radio, the station name now sits level with the play button when no song title is showing.
- On Windows, song titles read from the stream itself keep coming on a radio left playing all day. They used to stop after twelve hours.
- The Deskside Radio - Update shortcut in the Start menu has its own icon: the radio with an orange install badge, in the same style as the browser shortcuts.
- In the Analogue dial theme, the Deskside Radio name plate now matches the official wordmark: its letters are set into the gold and sit centred on the plate.

## Bug fixes

- Updating from the Start menu no longer runs the whole update a second time after "Press any key". Updating from 1.8.1 may still do it once, because the fix is in the new installer; from then on it will not.
- The x on the update notice is now centred in its circle.
